requirements.title: Cognitive Loop Core Functionality
requirements.description: Cognitive Loop must record Trace / Summary / Lessons and write valuable info to STS.

requirements.title: Memory Fabric Basic Operations
requirements.description: Memory Fabric must support atomic remembering and querying.

requirements.title: Memory Fabric Hybrid Recall
requirements.description: MemoryFabric.recall must support text_only/vector_only/hybrid and emit debug trace when enabled.

requirements.title: SQLite Vec Store Optional Backend
requirements.description: SqliteVecMemoryStore must exist and be selectable via env/config with safe fallback to SQLite.

requirements.title: Embedding Provider Fallback
requirements.description: Embedding client factory must support fallback and expose health snapshot.

requirements.title: Lane Concurrency Control
requirements.description: LaneManager must provide per-lane concurrency control for session/global boundaries.

requirements.title: SafetyKernel Guard Action
requirements.description: SafetyKernel.guard_action must exist and be used by llm/tool/code-patch critical paths.

requirements.title: Tool Policy Stacking and Hooks
requirements.description: Tool manager must support before_tool_call hooks and policy stacking for allow/deny enforcement.

requirements.title: FailoverReason Classifier
requirements.description: Failover classifier must bucket common provider errors for fast recovery.

requirements.title: Auth Profiles Store and Rotation
requirements.description: Auth profile store must support cooldown/disable and selection strategy for failover.

requirements.title: Canonical ModelRouter
requirements.description: Canonical router must be callable and provide structured routing decisions with logging.

requirements.title: Eval Harness Run Suite
requirements.description: EvalHarness must be able to run a suite and aggregate metrics for A/B decisions.

requirements.title: Experiment Orchestrator Promote Variant
requirements.description: ExperimentOrchestrator must support decide-and-promote variant for L3->L2->L1 feedback loop.

requirements.title: Observability Snapshot Blueprint Maps
requirements.description: SystemSnapshot must include blueprint_* maps for coverage analyzer inputs.

requirements.title: Blueprint Coverage Report Script Runs
requirements.description: Coverage report script must run end-to-end without crashing.

requirements.title: Self Evolution State Store Persistence
requirements.description: SelfEvolutionStateStore must implement schema-stable load/save under data/.

requirements.title: SkillExecutor Executes Builtins
requirements.description: SkillExecutor must execute at least builtin skills end-to-end for TaskExecutor plans.

requirements.title: ProgrammerAgent Generates Modifications
requirements.description: ProgrammerAgent must translate DevPlan work_items into FileModification list using registered tools.

requirements.title: BlueprintImprover Does Not Guess Paths
requirements.description: BlueprintImprover must not target non-existent files when converting gaps to patch issues.

requirements.title: Research Runners Avoid Synthetic Metrics
requirements.description: PatchEvalRunner and SkillEvolutionRunner must not emit synthetic metrics unless explicitly enabled.

requirements.title: Self-Programming Engine V2 Core Loop
requirements.description: Self-Programming Engine V2 must support gap analysis and code generation.
